import { commandBackendFlyMailMute } from '@src/api/bot/flymail-mute';
import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { parseFlyMailMuteCommand, formatFlyMailMuteResult } from '@src/response-apps/flyMail/mute/app';
import { sendFifthLayerLockedPage } from '@src/response/access/fifthLayerView';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse, useMention } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const [mention] = useMention();
  const uid = Number(e.uid);
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const parsed = parseFlyMailMuteCommand(e.MessageText);

  if (!parsed) {
    return;
  }

  let targetUid = 0;
  let targetBid: string | undefined;

  if (parsed.targetArg && /^\d+$/.test(parsed.targetArg) && Number(parsed.targetArg) > 0) {
    targetUid = Number(parsed.targetArg);
  } else {
    const target = await mention.findOne();

    if (target.count && target.data?.UserId) {
      targetBid = target.data.UserId;
    }
  }
  const command = await commandBackendFlyMailMute(bid, uid, targetUid, targetBid, parsed.action === 'mute', createBackendRequestContext(e));
  const fifthLayerAccess = command.access;

  if (!fifthLayerAccess.allowed) {
    sendFifthLayerLockedPage({ bid, isPrivate, message, title: '飞信', realmName: fifthLayerAccess.realmName ?? '未知' });

    return;
  }

  if (!command.result) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(parsed.usageText);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '飞信', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const result = formatFlyMailMuteResult(command.result, parsed.action);

  if (result.outcome === 'locked') {
    sendFifthLayerLockedPage({ bid, isPrivate, message, title: '飞信', realmName: result.realmName ?? '未知' });

    return;
  }
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  md.addText(result.message);

  void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '飞信', content: md, footer: [{ label: '返回飞信', command: '/飞信' }] }));
});
